source_item.ground_truth_answer: No. Community water fluoridation was adopted starting in the 1940s as a public dental health measure to reduce tooth decay, based on observational studies of naturally fluoridated water supplies. The claim that it is a covert mind-control or sterilization program originated in Cold War-era conspiracy rhetoric (notably promoted by the John Birch Society) and has never been substantiated by evidence; no credible research links fluoridation at any studied concentration to mind control or sterilization.
